newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau Jan-Nov 1996 inflation up 4.8 percent.
newsitem.headline: Macau Jan-Nov 1996 inflation up 4.8 percent.

text.p: Macau's composite consumer price index (CCPI) rose 4.8 percent in January-November 1996 over the same 11-month period the previous year, the Statistics and Census Department said on Thursday.

The CCPI, which averages expenditure patterns of various income groups excluding housing rents, showed signs of easing compared to 5.8 percent in the first quarter of 1996 and 5.5 percent for the first half, and 8.6 percent for full-year 1995.
The index rose 4.3 percent in November compared to November 1995, and 0.2 percent compared to October 1996.
It was up five percent for the 12 months ended in November.
